tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a low wooden crate and pushes its lid open with one flat open palm, keeping the other arm relaxed at its side while looking into the box.
tasks.camera: medium side view at crate level
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pushing hand is fully open and flat, palm and all five fingers facing the viewer clearly.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲下用摊开的手掌推开木箱盖子

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged on a cushion, the blue tiger holds a small open book against its knee with one hand while the other hand rests open and flat on the cushion beside it, palm upward.
tasks.camera: three-quarter front view at seated eye level
tasks.visibility_requirement: The resting hand shows a fully visible upward palm with all five fingers separated; the book-holding hand is relaxed and partly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘腿坐着看书，另一只手摊开放松

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances a round wooden bowl on its open upturned palm above shoulder height, arm extended, head tilted to watch the bowl wobble, body leaning slightly for balance.
tasks.camera: medium full-body shot from slight low angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: The balancing palm is fully open under the bowl with all five fingers visible around its rim.
tasks.intent_zh: 单手托碗保持平衡，抬头看着它晃动

tasks.instruction: Kneeling on one knee, the blue tiger reaches into a woven basket of apples, one open palm extended toward the fruit while the other hand steadies the basket rim from outside, gaze downward.
tasks.camera: medium three-quarter view from the front
tasks.visibility_requirement: The reaching hand is shown open with palm and five fingers clearly exposed above the basket contents.
tasks.intent_zh: 单膝跪地伸手进篮子拿苹果

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans against a doorframe and presses an open flat palm against the door to hold it ajar, peeking through the gap with an alert expression, other arm hanging loosely.
tasks.camera: medium side view along the doorframe
tasks.visibility_requirement: The palm pressed on the door is fully visible and flat, fingers spread and not curled.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠在门框边用手掌撑开门缝偷看

tasks.instruction: Crouched low near the ground, the blue tiger places an open palm flat on the floor to steady itself while reaching a lantern toward a wall shelf with the other arm, tail curled up.
tasks.camera: low angle medium shot from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: The floor-planted hand is fully open with palm and five fingers pressed flat and clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲低一手撑地，另一手举灯去够架子

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands at a potter's wheel, both hands wet, one open palm smoothing the clay wall while the other supports the outside of the vase, sleeves rolled up, head bowed in focus.
tasks.camera: medium close-up from above the wheel
tasks.visibility_requirement: The smoothing palm faces outward with all five fingers visible against the clay; the support hand is also visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 在陶轮旁双手塑形，一手掌抹平陶壁

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a park bench, the blue tiger tosses a small ball up with one open palm and watches it rise, the other arm draped over the bench back, legs stretched out.
tasks.camera: medium full-body side view at bench height
tasks.visibility_requirement: The tossing palm faces upward, fully open with all five fingers visible as the ball leaves it.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在长椅上用手掌抛接小球

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger bends over a large paper map spread on a table, one open palm pressed flat on a corner to hold it down, the other hand pointing at a route, ears tilted forward.
tasks.camera: medium high-angle view over the table
tasks.visibility_requirement: The flat holding palm is fully visible with five spread fingers; the pointing hand is also clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身看地图，一手压住纸角一手比划路线

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a low stool, the blue tiger ladles water from a bucket with one hand and cups the other open palm under the ladle to catch drips, leaning forward over the pail.
tasks.camera: medium front view slightly above
tasks.visibility_requirement: The catching palm is open and upward with all five fingers visible and unobstructed by the ladle.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐凳上用勺子舀水，另一手摊开接水滴

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger nimbly steps along a garden path carrying a stack of folded towels, one open palm supporting the bottom of the stack while the other hand rests on top, head turned toward a bird.
tasks.camera: medium tracking side view
tasks.visibility_requirement: The supporting hand under the stack shows an open palm with all five fingers visible beneath the towels.
tasks.intent_zh: 抱着一叠毛巾走路，一手掌托着底部

tasks.instruction: Kneeling beside a soaking rag, the blue tiger wipes a spilled puddle on the floor with one open flat palm, the other hand braced on its knee, looking down at the wet mark.
tasks.camera: medium high angle from behind and above
tasks.visibility_requirement: The wiping palm is flat and fully visible against the floor with five spread fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪地用摊开的手掌擦地上的水渍

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands at a fishing pond edge, holding a rod with one hand while the other open palm shields its eyes from the sun as it scans the water, feet planted apart.
tasks.camera: medium wide side view with pond in front
tasks.visibility_requirement: The shading palm is flat and open above the eyes with all five fingers visible and separated.
tasks.intent_zh: 站在池塘边一手握竿一手遮阳眺望

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels by a cardboard box and gently lifts a small kitten out with one cradling hand while the other open palm stays flat beneath as support, looking down tenderly.
tasks.camera: medium close-up from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: The support palm is open and flat under the kitten with all five fingers visible around it.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪着轻轻托起小猫，另一手掌在下方护着

tasks.instruction: Seated on the floor with legs stretched forward, the blue tiger rolls a wooden toy car along the ground with one open flat palm, the other hand resting open on its thigh.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter view from the front
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pushing palm is fully visible and flat on the car; the thigh-resting open hand is also clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐地上用手掌推玩具车，另一手放腿上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger climbs a short wooden ladder, one open palm gripping the side rail with fingers spread, the other hand reaching to the next rung, body angled upward.
tasks.camera: medium low-angle view from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: The rail-holding hand is shown as an open palm with all five long fingers visible against the wood.
tasks.intent_zh: 爬木梯，一手张开抓栏杆一手够横档

tasks.instruction: Bending at the waist, the blue tiger pours seeds from a paper bag into a bird feeder, holding the bag with one hand and catching stray seeds in the other open cupped palm below.
tasks.camera: medium front view at waist height
tasks.visibility_requirement: The cupped catching palm is fully visible with all five fingers and palm surface shown openly.
tasks.intent_zh: 弯腰倒种子喂鸟，另一手摊开接住漏下的

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swing, one open palm flat on the chain beside it, the other hand resting in its lap, legs dangling and swinging gently, head tilted up.
tasks.camera: medium front view at swing height
tasks.visibility_requirement: The chain-holding palm is open and flat with five fingers visible, not curled around the chain.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在秋千上，一手掌搭在链子上轻轻荡

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans over a wooden fence to pet a sheep, one open palm extended flat toward the animal's head while the other hand grips the top rail, tail swaying.
tasks.camera: medium side view at fence height
tasks.visibility_requirement: The extended petting palm is fully open and flat with all five fingers visible toward the sheep.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在木栅栏上摊开手掌摸羊

tasks.instruction: Crouched on a rocky shore, the blue tiger dips one open palm into a tide pool and lifts it dripping, watching the water run off its fingers, the other hand steadying itself on a stone.
tasks.camera: medium close high angle from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: The lifted palm is fully open toward the viewer with all five slender fingers and palm clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在潮池边用手掌舀水看它流下来

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands in a kitchen cracking an egg against a bowl rim with one hand, the other open palm held beneath to catch any shell, leaning over the counter.
tasks.camera: medium close-up over the counter
tasks.visibility_requirement: The catching palm below is open and fully visible with five separated fingers, unobstructed by the bowl.
tasks.intent_zh: 在厨房单手打蛋，另一手掌在下面接蛋壳

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a low wall, the blue tiger brushes dust from its knee with one open flat palm, the other hand holding a soft brush loosely, face turned toward the sunset.
tasks.camera: medium side view at wall height
tasks.visibility_requirement: The brushing palm is flat and fully visible against the knee with all five fingers spread.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在矮墙上用手掌拍掉膝盖的灰尘

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels to tie a ribbon around a gift box, one open palm pressing the bow flat while the other hand pulls the ribbon end, tongue slightly out in concentration.
tasks.camera: medium close high angle from the front
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pressing palm is open and flat on the bow with all five fingers visible around the ribbon.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪着系礼盒丝带，一手掌按住蝴蝶结

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits under a tree reading a letter, holding the paper with one hand while the other open palm rests on the grass beside it, palm up, enjoying the shade.
tasks.camera: medium wide front view at ground level
tasks.visibility_requirement: The grass-resting palm is open upward with all five fingers and yellow pad clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 在树下读信，另一只手掌摊在草地上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a bicycle and presses an open flat palm against the tire to check the pressure, the other hand on the handlebar, brow furrowed in thought.
tasks.camera: low medium side view at wheel height
tasks.visibility_requirement: The tire-pressing palm is fully visible and flat with five fingers spread against the rubber.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在自行车旁用手掌按轮胎试气压

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reaches up to a high shelf with one open palm outstretched to grab a jar, standing on tiptoe with the other arm out for balance, tail lifted.
tasks.camera: medium low-angle full-body view from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: The outstretched reaching palm is open toward the shelf with all five fingers visible and separated.
tasks.intent_zh: 踮脚伸手够高架上的罐子

tasks.instruction: Seated at a piano, the blue tiger presses keys with one hand while the other rests open and flat on the wood beside the keys, head tilted as it listens to the note.
tasks.camera: medium three-quarter view over the shoulder onto keys
tasks.visibility_requirement: The resting open palm on the piano wood is fully visible with all five fingers relaxed and spread.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在钢琴前弹奏，另一手掌摊在琴木上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger bends over a sink washing a mug, one open palm scrubbing inside the rim while the other hand holds the mug steady under running water, sleeves pushed up.
tasks.camera: medium close-up over the sink at chest height
tasks.visibility_requirement: The scrubbing palm is open toward the viewer inside the mug rim with five fingers visible above the edge.
tasks.intent_zh: 在水池边用手掌洗杯子

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans out of a window to water plants, one open palm tipping the watering can while the other hand braces on the sill, sunlight on its fur.
tasks.camera: medium side view from outside the window
tasks.visibility_requirement: The bracing palm on the sill is flat and fully visible with all five fingers spread on the wood.
tasks.intent_zh: 探出窗户浇植物，另一手掌撑在窗台上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a cushion and holds a large seashell to its ear with one hand, the other open palm resting on the floor beside it, eyes closed peacefully.
tasks.camera: medium front view at seated eye level
tasks.visibility_requirement: The floor-resting palm is open and upward with all five fingers and yellow palm pad clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐着把贝壳贴在耳边听，另一手掌摊在地板上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches in a garden and presses an open flat palm into the soil to firm a newly planted seedling, the other hand holding a trowel beside it.
tasks.camera: low medium view from ground level at the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: The soil-pressing palm is flat and fully visible with five fingers spread against the dirt.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在花园里用手掌压实新栽苗的土
